chain_words.nuance: mild sleepiness, feeling ready to nod off
fatigue that builds up over time
extreme fatigue that leaves little energy
energy or resources completely used up

explanation: These words all describe a lack of energy, from mild sleepiness to a state where all energy has been used up.

usage_notes.difference: 'Tired' describes ordinary fatigue that rest can usually fix; 'exhausted' describes extreme fatigue that leaves a person unable to continue.
